claims.says: For any numeric scanner and escape check, with enough fuel the lexer loop never slices off a character boundary, and its whitespace runs and tokens concatenate back to the input.
Wherever the modelled openCypher comment and whitespace rule (space, tab, CR, LF only) accepts a run, read_spaces skips exactly that many bytes.
Whenever the openCypher escape decoding accepts a string body, cypher_unescape decodes it to the same string.
For any non-empty digit string in any radix, negated or not, the integer literal path gives the literal's value when it fits i64 and an error otherwise, never a wrapped value.
Every expression tree built along the modelled parser paths, with each depth check passing, has height at most MAX_TREE_DEPTH (256).
